retrievalProfile.description: A framed studio portrait with a heavy black outer border and delicate monoline script typography positioned along the top edge.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, warm-toned studio portrait of a subject with soft lighting, encased in a thin peach-colored frame which is itself surrounded by a wide black border. The top margin features elegant, thin monoline script text integrated with horizontal lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a nested frame structure
Warm skin tones contrasting against a dark, neutral background
Delicate script typography balancing the heavy black border
Soft-focus texture throughout the photographic element
coreInvariants: Monoline script at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait centered, filling approximately 70% of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, highlighted by warm directional light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top script text down into the subject's face, then out to the dark borders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the wide black border and the dark background behind the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in the highlights of the face; deep shadows in the hair and border.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal entry and exit strokes that form lines
Low x-height with long, looping ascenders and descenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters integrated into a continuous horizontal line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single monoline script used for all text elements to maintain elegance.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines connecting to text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the monoline, casual script feel.
Provides the basic monoline cursive skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm-toned studio portrait of a person with soft lighting and a dark background, centered within a thin peach frame and a wide black outer border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin monoline script text in peach-cream color along the top black border, with horizontal lines extending from the letters to the edges.

verificationChecks: Is the black border wide and prominent?
Is the lighting on the subject soft and warm?
Is the text monoline and positioned at the very top?
Is there a thin peach frame separating the photo from the black border?

adjustableVariables: Color of the inner frame line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script is legible but delicate.
Verify the warm color temperature of the portrait.
Check that the black border is perfectly symmetrical.
Confirm the horizontal lines align with the text height.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered soft-focus portrait + add a thin peach inner frame + surround with a wide black border + place monoline script with horizontal extensions at the top edge.
